content: GA4 sets cookies and typically needs a consent banner in the EU, and an independent study found GA4 captured only ~55% of real traffic due to consent declines. Plausible, Cloudflare Web Analytics, Fathom, Umami are cookieless with no personal data, no consent banner needed. Cloudflare Web Analytics is free/unlimited if reasonable to add (does not require being proxied through Cloudflare for basic JS-beacon mode). Plausible is /mo for 10k pageviews, has best UX/reporting for a small studio wanting simple traffic + referrer source data.
